tools.name: MigrateStatsigFeatureGatesToWingify
tools.description: Migrate Statsig feature gates to Wingify FE. For each Statsig feature gate this tool: (1) lists all gates from Statsig, (2) maps each gate to a Wingify feature flag payload, (3) creates the feature flag in Wingify with a default boolean variable, and (4) creates rollout rules from the gate's rules with Statsig conditions mapped to Wingify globalSegment where supported. Rollout rules are enabled when the Statsig gate is enabled; the feature flag itself stays disabled after migration.

environmentIdOrKey.description: Target Wingify environment id or key for the rollout rule. Defaults to Production (id "1").

includeArchived.description: Whether to also migrate archived Statsig feature gates.

tools.name: MigrateStatsigDynamicConfigsToWingify
tools.description: Migrate Statsig dynamic configs to Wingify FE. For each dynamic config this tool: (1) lists all dynamic configs from Statsig, (2) creates a Wingify feature flag whose variables come from defaultValue (labels are applied only when the config has Statsig tags), (3) always creates a rollout rule for the default variation first, then (4) for each Statsig rule with multiple variants, creates Wingify variations from those variants and a FLAG_TESTING rule; for rules with a single variant (or rule-level returnValue only), creates a personalize rule. Rules are enabled when the dynamic config is enabled; the feature flag itself stays disabled after migration.

environmentIdOrKey.description: Target Wingify environment id or key for the created rules. Defaults to Production (id "1").

tools.name: MigrateStatsigExperimentsToWingify
tools.description: Migrate Statsig experiments to Wingify FE. For each experiment this tool: (1) lists all experiments from Statsig, (2) creates a Wingify feature flag whose variables are derived from the experiment's parameters (the control group provides the defaults, with an inferred data type per parameter), attaching all equivalent Wingify metrics from the experiment's primaryMetrics and secondaryMetrics when they exist in Wingify — the first primary metric is the sole Wingify primary goal, all other attached metrics are secondary — (3) creates a variation for each non-control group from its parameterValues, and (4) creates a FLAG_TESTING rule that splits traffic across the control (default) and variations by each group's size. The testing rule is enabled when the Statsig experiment is live (status active or running), using rule ids from the create response; the feature flag itself stays disabled after migration. Run metrics migration first so product/custom metrics exist in Wingify.

environmentIdOrKey.description: Target Wingify environment id or key for the testing rule. Defaults to Production (id "1").

tools.name: MigrateStatsigParameterStoresToWingify
tools.description: Migrate Statsig parameter stores to Wingify FE. For each parameter store this tool: (1) lists all parameter stores from Statsig, (2) creates a Wingify feature flag whose variables come from the store parameters (one typed variable per parameter), and (3) creates a single FLAG_ROLLOUT rule (100%) that serves the default variation, so resolving the flag returns the parameter values. Labels are applied only when the parameter store has Statsig tags.

environmentIdOrKey.description: Target Wingify environment id or key for the created rollout rule. Defaults to Production (id "1").

tools.name: MigrateStatsigMetricsToWingify
tools.description: Migrate metrics to Wingify Data360: custom-event metrics and product metrics (DAU, WAU, MAU, retention, etc.). For each metric: skip if the Wingify metric already exists, create a custom Wingify event when missing, then create a Wingify metric (custom-conversion / triggered). Product metrics get synthetic custom events named from the metric. Standard Wingify events are never used.

showHiddenMetrics.description: Whether to include hidden Statsig metrics when listing from Statsig.

tools.name: MigrateAllStatsigToWingify
tools.description: Migrate everything from Statsig to Wingify FE (Feature Experimentation) in one go: custom-event metrics, feature gates, dynamic configs, experiments, and parameter stores. Use this for any general migration request (e.g. "migrate from Statsig to Wingify") that does not name a specific entity type. In user-facing output, refer to the product as "Wingify FE" or "Feature Experimentation". Runs all migrations in order and returns a single consolidated summary.

environmentIdOrKey.description: Target Wingify environment id or key for the created rules. Defaults to Production (id "1").

includeArchived.description: Whether to also migrate archived Statsig feature gates.
